summary: Reads a 2-byte big-endian size field followed by a 2-byte big-endian token value from a byte stream, refilling the stream via a callback whenever the remaining-byte count hits zero. Requires the size to equal exactly 4; on mismatch it sets the dispatcher state to 9 and invokes the vtable entry 0 error path. On success it sets the dispatcher state to 81, stores the parsed value at obj+0x18 and this+0xFC, invokes vtable entry 4 with (v1, 1), advances the read pointer, decrements the remaining count, and returns 1.

operations.description: Load stream state: v2 = *(this+0x14) (the stream read-state struct), v3 = its remaining-byte count at offset 0x4, v4 = its read pointer at offset 0x0.
If the remaining-byte count is zero, call the refill callback v2[3] (offset 0xC of the stream state) and reload read pointer and count; abort with return 0 when the refill fails.
Read the first byte at the read pointer (field *(*(this+0x14)+0x0)) as the high byte of a 16-bit big-endian size and decrement the remaining count by one.
If the remaining count reaches zero before the second size byte is read, refill again via v2[3] and abort with return 0 on failure.

Combine the second size byte into the 16-bit size value; if the size does not equal 4, set the dispatcher state obj+0x14 to 9 and invoke the vtable entry at obj+0x0 (the state dispatcher object is reached through the pointer at this+0x0).
If the remaining count reaches zero before reading the token high byte, refill again via v2[3] and abort with return 0 on failure.
Read the token value as a 16-bit big-endian quantity from the stream's remaining two bytes at the read pointer.

Commit the token: set the dispatcher state obj+0x14 to 81, store the parsed value at obj+0x18, invoke the vtable entry at obj+0x4 with (v1, 1), store the value at this+0xFC, advance the read pointer (field 0x0 of the stream state) and decrement the remaining count (field 0x4), then return 1.
